name: Day
overview: Scripture reveals the concept of 'Day' beginning with the creative periods described in Genesis 1, where each day is marked by an evening and a morning, culminating in the sixth day of creation when God saw all He had made was very good. These days are foundational, representing both the physical division of time into working days and the spiritual significance attributed to various days, such as the Lord's day and the Sabbath. The biblical day is not only a measure of time but also carries prophetic and spiritual meaning, including themes of judgment, illumination, adversity, and rest.
